test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A thief noticed a policeman at a distance of 500 m away from him. The thief starts running at a speed of 60 km/h and the policeman chased him running at a speed of 70 km/h. Find the time taken by the policeman to catch the thief (in minutes).
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between the thief and the policeman = 500 m.

Speed of the thief = 60 km/h.

Speed of the policeman = 70 km/h.

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed = Speed of policeman - Speed of thief

⇒ Relative Speed = 70 km/h - 60 km/h = 10 km/h

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 10 × 5/18 = 50/18 m/s

Time taken by the policeman to catch the thief = 500 / (50/18)

⇒ Time = 500 × 18 / 50

⇒ Time = 180

⇒ Time = 3 minutes

**The time taken by the policeman to catch the thief is 3 minutes.**
